visual_observations: Normal, grayscale and one deuteranopia simulation were opened and inspected. A and B remain identifiable by labels, contour and section placement.
The final upper-notch leader ends on the visible A notch floor; the lower-notch leader ends on B's lower-notch boundary.
The central section shows touching z=8 boundaries with no gap or overlapping colored area.
The separated view retains some projected occlusion; the labeled central section carries the exact contact, and the actual 3D bounds do not intersect.
Fine antialiasing seams remain between some coplanar polygons in the raster assembly view. These are export seams, not modeled material boundaries.
